integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the variable-momentum Hamilton-Jacobi potentials from the source equations, differentiates the resulting endpoint bound, proves strict convexity, and constructs the equality curve from the closing equation. The endpoint asymptotics follow from uniform large-momentum expansions. Numerical checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem solves the auxiliary causal-curve variational problem at fixed turning parameter. It does not change the global sharp Santaló constant or equality classification of the source. The source already notes qualitatively that variable momentum gives the exact fixed-parameter value; the new claims are the explicit objective and closing equation, strict uniqueness, characteristic realization, endpoint value, and sharp boundary asymptotics.
title: Exact fixed-turning phase diagram for the slab Santaló path problem
